Root.description:
Represents the switch itself.
Renders a `<span>` element and a hidden `<input>` beside.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the switch is initially active. To render a controlled switch, use the `checked` prop instead.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the switch is currently active. To render an uncontrolled switch, use the `defaultChecked` prop instead.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Event handler called when the switch is activated or deactivated.

props.name: value
props.description:
The value submitted with the form when the switch is on.
By default, switch submits the "on" value, matching native checkbox behavior.

props.name: form
props.description:
Identifies the form that owns the hidden input.
Useful when the switch is rendered outside the form.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

props.name: uncheckedValue
props.description:
The value submitted with the form when the switch is off.
By default, unchecked switches do not submit any value, matching native checkbox behavior.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to activate or deactivate the switch.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must activate the switch before submitting a form.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden `<input>` element.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the hidden input element. When `nativeButton` is `true`, the id is applied to the root element.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is not checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is in a valid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is in an invalid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch's value has changed (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch has been touched (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is active (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is focused (when wrapped in Field.Root).

additionalTypes.name: Root.State
Root.ChangeEventDetails
